subject: Offline badge reads + HubSpot fallback: mapping & dry-run
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@acmeevents.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Events Tech <tech@acmeevents.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: (wip) Redwood + Acme onsite scanning: offline behavior and HubSpot fallback

Hi Vanessa / Laura,

Quick follow-up from our integration call this morning. We need to lock a few decisions before the Summit dry-run:

- Offline reads: scanners will store badge scans locally when network is absent. We can export a CSV at the end of day or push automatically when connectivity returns. Which formatting does your HubSpot ingest expect?
- Deduping & identity: do you want email OR badge ID as the primary dedupe key? If we push both, what priority should Redwood take?
- Opt-in language: our team will show the consent banner on the iPad. We need your final language to render in the widget (max 280 chars).

I've attached the Acme dry-run checklist and our suggested offline export schema. If you can confirm mapping and the consent text by Wednesday EOD, our team can schedule the device firmware update for Thurs.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Integrations, Acme Events
sofia@acmeevents.com
Attachment: Acme_DryRun_Checklist.docx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@acmeevents.com>, Acme Events Tech <tech@acmeevents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (wip) Redwood + Acme onsite scanning: offline behavior and HubSpot fallback

Thanks Sofia — good notes. Attaching our current mapping (Leadflow_mapping_v1.xlsx) and the offline spec we've been piloting. A few clarifying points from our side:

- HubSpot ingest: prefer a single POST to the form endpoint per attendee. If multiple records come in with the same badge_id within 10 minutes, treat as the same session (we can do server-side dedupe).
- Primary dedupe key: email > badge_id. If email absent, use badge_id. Include device_id and event_id in payload for debugging.
- Consent language: draft below (feel free to shorten):
  "By providing your badge, you agree to receive event-related communications from Redwood Inference and our partners. Data will be stored for 12 months and used to follow up about product updates and event materials."

Open questions for you:
1) Can Acme include badge photos in the offline export? (we'd prefer not unless encrypted)
2) Will the CSV include local timestamps in UTC?
3) For attendees who opt-out at the booth, can Acme pass opt_out=true in the payload so we skip HubSpot creation?

Proposed next steps:
- We sign off on mapping + consent text (this thread)
- We run an end-to-end dry-run Thurs 22 Apr 10:00 PST
- Post-dry-run we agree on a fallback SLA for delayed pushes (max 24 hours)

Thanks — I can join a quick call Tues morning if helpful.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: Leadflow_mapping_v1.xlsx; Redwood_Offline_Spec.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (wip) Redwood + Acme onsite scanning: offline behavior and HubSpot fallback

Quick note from the ops side:

- SFDC middleware: if HubSpot pushes are delayed > 4 hours, the middleware should mark records as "delayed_ingest" and attach original device_id so our CS team can triage.
- Deduping: recommend we include an additional fallback key: phone_normalized (if present) for mobile-only badges.
- Pricing/legal: if Acme needs guaranteed <1 hour replays for VIP badge reads, we should flag as an SLA add-on in the contract.

I'll review the mapping sheet and add a few fields (device_firmware, push_retry_count).

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Acme Events Tech <tech@acmeevents.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (wip) Redwood + Acme onsite scanning: offline behavior and HubSpot fallback

Hi all — answers inline.

> Can Acme include badge photos in the offline export?
We can include them but only as base64 JPG attachments; default is no to keep file sizes down. If Redwood opts in we can enable encryption at rest for images.

> Will the CSV include local timestamps in UTC?
Yes — local device timestamps will be normalized to UTC in the export.

> For attendees who opt-out at the booth, can Acme pass opt_out=true?
Yes — opt_out and opt_source fields will be present. If opt_out=true we will not include contact fields (email/phone) in the export; we only pass badge_id and opt flags.

We've also uploaded a signed MSA amendment for the Summit (DocuSign): https://docusign.com/rc/EnvelopeId-ABC123456 — please review and countersign.

Also setting up Thurs 22 Apr 10:00 PST for the dry-run. We'll push a device firmware with retry_count=5 and 30s backoff.

— Acme Events Tech
Attachment: none (DocuSign link included)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@acmeevents.com>, Acme Events Tech <tech@acmeevents.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (wip) Redwood + Acme onsite scanning: offline behavior and HubSpot fallback

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Finalizing acceptance here and calling out the runbook we will follow for the dry-run: 

1) Preflight (Thurs 22 Apr 08:30 PST) — device inventory, confirm firmware v2.1.4, confirm event_id and device_ids in manifest (Leadflow_mapping_v1.xlsx)
2) Dry-run (Thurs 22 Apr 10:00 PST) — 10 test scans per device, simulate offline mode on 2 devices, verify CSV export and HubSpot form POSTs (https://hubspot.redwood.com/forms/summit-2026-qr)
3) Post-run (Thurs 22 Apr 12:00 PST) — verify ingestion, run dedupe job, and file an incident if any delayed pushes exceed 24 hours

Open action items:
- Sofia: confirm whether Acme will include badge photos (yes/no) by Wed EOD (needed for privacy checklist).
- Ben: add middleware flags (delayed_ingest and push_retry_count) to mapping and share by Wed noon.
- Laura: prepare a short guidance note for CS about the delayed_ingest state (one-pager).

If everyone is aligned I'll countersign the DocuSign by Wed and confirm the dry-run on calendar.

Thanks — see you on Thurs.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Attachment: Redwood_Offline_Spec.pdf
